decisions.rationale: Intended Mega: Swampert-Mega. Lead Farigiraf+Gholdengo: Farigiraf sets TR (survives ZardY SolarBeam 28-66% and HeatWave 38-88%), Armor Tail blocks opposing priority FakeOut. Under TR, Gholdengo (104 Spe) outspeeds ZardY and Thunderbolt does 41-110% (likely KO after any chip). Back Incineroar+Swampert-Mega: Incineroar Intimidate+FakeOut control, Swampert-Mega Swift Swim flips to slow-under-TR sweeper with Waterfall/HHP/Ice Punch. This directly counters the ZardY sun speed axis.
decisions.notebook: Opponent team: ZardY (Drought Mega, Timid, 115-167 Spe), Whimsicott (Prankster Sash, Tailwind/Encore), Archaludon (Stamina Modest, ElectroShot), Grimmsnarl (Prankster LightClay, FakeOut/Screens), Stunfisk-Galar (Mimicry Adamant, EQ/StealthRock), Quaquaval (Moxie Jolly LifeOrb). Key: ZardY Heat Wave OHKOs Gholdengo in sun (83-202%). Gholdengo Thunderbolt possible OHKO on ZardY (41-110%). Incineroar takes 15-37% from ZardY Heat Wave (safe switch). Farigiraf survives all ZardY single-target hits. Armor Tail blocks Grimmsnarl/Whimsicott priority. Plan: TR mode to flip speed tier vs ZardY+Tailwind. Swampert-Mega Swift Swim under rain OR slow under TR both viable depending on weather control. Watch for Whimsicott Encore locking TR or setup moves.

decisions.rationale: Lead Charizard+Whimsicott to immediately cancel Rain with Drought and disrupt setup with Prankster Encore/Tailwind. Archaludon handles Pelipper with Thunderbolt, Grimmsnarl provides FakeOut priority and FoulPlay for Gholdengo/Farigiraf. Mega Charizard Y is the win condition, outspeeding Swift Swim Swampert under Sun and hitting hard with HeatWave/SolarBeam.
decisions.notebook: Opponent runs Rain + Mega Swampert core with Farigiraf TR support. Gholdengo blocks status with Good as Gold. Incineroar provides Intimidate + FakeOut. Klefki offers Prankster screens. Plan: Mega Charizard Y cancels Rain, Whimsicott disrupts with Encore/Tailwind, Archaludon removes Pelipper, Grimmsnarl handles Gholdengo/Farigiraf with FoulPlay. Watch for Trick Room turns where Whimsicott can Encore Farigiraf.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Gholdengo)
decisions.rationale: ZardY outspeeds Gholdengo and Heat Wave OHKOs it (59-261% in sun). Gholdengo must Protect. Farigiraf TR at priority -7 goes last but Armor Tail blocks Whimsicott Prankster Encore, so TR is safe to set up. If Zard uses spread Heat Wave, Farigiraf takes 29-137% (not guaranteed KO). Under TR next turn, both my mons outspeed ZardY+Whimsicott, flipping the game. If opponent Tailwinds, that makes them even slower under TR.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Opponent leads ZardY+Whimsicott (Prankster Sash). Armor Tail confirmed blocking Prankster Encore/Taunt on both my active mons — key TR insurance. ZardY Heat Wave spread in sun: 59-261% on Gholdengo (likely OHKO), 29-137% on Farigiraf (not guaranteed). Plan: TR turn 1 with Gholdengo Protect, then sweep under TR with Gholdengo Thunderbolt on ZardY and Farigiraf support. If opponent sets Tailwind under TR, it backfires (makes them slower). Watch for opponent switching to Grimmsnarl for Screens+FakeOut or Archaludon for ElectroShot under TR. Swampert-Mega Swift Swim needs rain — no rain setter on my team, so Swampert is primarily a TR attacker (base 70 Spe). Incineroar is safe switch into ZardY Heat Wave (15-37%).

decisions.rationale: Mega Charizard Y Heat Wave is 2x vs Gholdengo with possible OHKO (43-122%) and Drought cancels future Rain. Whimsicott Tailwind sets speed control; Focus Sash survives Make It Rain. Farigiraf Trick Room at -7 moves last so Heat Wave lands first. This pressures Gholdengo immediately while establishing speed advantage for turns 2-4.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Opponent leads Farigiraf + Gholdengo. Plan: Mega Charizard Y cancels Rain, Whimsicott disrupts with Encore/Tailwind, Archaludon removes Pelipper, Grimmsnarl handles Gholdengo/Farigiraf with FoulPlay. Gholdengo Good as Gold blocks status. Farigiraf likely Trick Room turn 1. Whimsicott Focus Sash survives Make It Rain. Watch for Pelipper + Swampert switch-in to activate Rain + Mega Swampert. Encore locks Trick Room if Farigiraf uses it. Tailwind + Drought gives speed and Fire boost. Archaludon ElectroShot + Grimmsnarl FoulPlay are key follow-ups.

decisions.rationale: Thunderbolt alone cannot OHKO Zard-Y (46-99%). Helping Hand (priority +5, goes first) boosts it to ~69-148%, very likely KOing Zard-Y before it can fire sun-boosted Heat Wave under TR. Farigiraf at 37% may fall to Moonblast but its TR job is done — trading Farigiraf for Zard-Y is winning. If Zard-Y Protects, opponent also wastes a sun turn.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Opponent leads ZardY+Whimsicott (Prankster Sash). Armor Tail confirmed blocking Prankster Encore/Taunt on both my active mons — key TR insurance. ZardY Heat Wave spread in sun: 59-261% on Gholdengo (likely OHKO), 29-137% on Farigiraf (not guaranteed). Plan: TR turn 1 with Gholdengo Protect, then sweep under TR with Gholdengo Thunderbolt on ZardY and Farigiraf support. If opponent sets Tailwind under TR, it backfires (makes them slower). Watch for opponent switching to Grimmsnarl for Screens+FakeOut or Archaludon for ElectroShot under TR. Swampert-Mega Swift Swim needs rain — no rain setter on my team, so Swampert is primarily a TR attacker (base 70 Spe). Incineroar is safe switch into ZardY Heat Wave (15-37%). Thunderbolt without Helping Hand cannot OHKO ZardY (46-99%); HH Thunderbolt ~69-148% likely OHKOs. Whimsicott Moonblast 15-67% on Farigiraf — can KO at 37%. If Farigiraf dies, Armor Tail drops and Prankster Encore becomes live on Gholdengo.

decisions.rationale: Incineroar's Fake Out (+3 pri) beats Prankster Encore (+1 pri), flinching Whimsicott to protect Gholdengo. Gholdengo Thunderbolt is guaranteed KO on Charizard at 32% even at -1 SpA. Incineroar also resists Heat Wave and brings Intimidate/Parting Shot for remaining TR turns. Swampert can't stop Encore and Swift Swim is dead in sun.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Opponent leads ZardY+Whimsicott(Prankster Sash). ZardY at 32% after T2 Thunderbolt — Gholdengo Thunderbolt guaranteed KO even at -1 SpA. Armor Tail (Farigiraf) is gone — Prankster Encore now live on Gholdengo; must use Fake Out (+3 pri) from Incineroar to flinch Whimsicott before Encore (+1 pri). TR has 3 usable turns after switch-in. Opponent Tailwind under TR makes all their mons move last — Gholdengo 104 Spe outspeeds under TR. Watch for Grimmsnarl Screens+Fakeout, Archaludon ElectroShot under TR, Quaquaval Moxie snowball, Stunfisk-Galar Mimicry+EQ. Swampert-Mega Swift Swim useless in sun — use as TR physical attacker (base 70 Spe). Incineroar key utility: Intimidate, Fake Out, Parting Shot pivot, WoW.

decisions.rationale: Heat Wave spread pressures both foes (SE vs Gholdengo 56.7-159.2%, neutral vs Farigiraf 27.8-82.8%). Moonblast on 36% Farigiraf (13.2-73.9%) maximizes KO chance. Under Trick Room foes move first; Whimsicott's Focus Sash survives Make It Rain. Even if Farigiraf Protects, Heat Wave still hits Gholdengo hard. Charizard risks Thunderbolt but likely survives low roll.

Plan: Mega Charizard Y cancels Rain, Whimsicott disrupts, Archaludon removes Pelipper, Grimmsnarl handles Gholdengo/Farigiraf with FoulPlay. Gholdengo Good as Gold blocks status. Farigiraf Trick Room turn 1. Whimsicott Focus Sash survives Make It Rain. Tailwind+Drought gives speed+Fire boost. Archaludon ElectroShot+Grimmsnarl FoulPlay key follow-ups. Trick Room active 4 turns; my fast mons move last. Heat Wave spread+Moonblast Farigiraf max pressure. Watch for Pelipper+Swampert switch to activate Rain+Mega Swampert.

decisions.rationale: Fake Out (+3 pri) outspeeds Prankster Encore (+1), flinching Whimsicott and protecting Gholdengo. Thunderbolt (2x SE on Fire/Flying) KOs ZardY at 32% even at -1 SpA in nearly all spreads. Under TR, Gholdengo moves before Tailwind-boosted foes. If ZardY Protects, Whimsicott is still flinched and we retain tempo with 2 TR turns left.

Armor Tail (Farigiraf) fainted — Prankster Encore now live on Gholdengo; must use Fake Out (+3 pri) from Incineroar to flinch Whimsicott before Encore (+1 pri). TR has 3 usable turns after switch-in. decisions.rationale: Under Trick Room opponents move first. Charizard at 33% risks KO from Gholdengo Thunderbolt (25-110%). Protect guarantees survival. Whimsicott Encore locks Gholdengo into Thunderbolt (last move turn 2), which is 0.5x on Whimsicott and survives via Focus Sash. Incineroar can't FakeOut (second turn active). Safe preservation sets up Trick Room expiry and Tailwind advantage.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Opponent leads Rain team (Pelipper+Swampert-Mega). Farigiraf fainted turn 2. Gholdengo -1 SpA, locked potential. Incineroar Sitrus Berry, Intimidate active. Plan: Mega Charizard Y cancels Rain with Drought, Whimsicott disrupts with Encore/Prankster, Archaludon ElectroShot removes Pelipper, Grimmsnarl FoulPlay handles Gholdengo/Farigiraf. Trick Room turn 1 gave opponents speed control. Tailwind+Drought provides speed+Fire boost. Key follow-ups: Archaludon ElectroShot+Grimmsnarl FoulPlay. Watch for Pelipper+Swampert switch activating Rain+Mega Swampert. Gholdengo Good as Gold blocks status. Whimsicott Focus Sash intact.

decisions.rationale: Thunderbolt guaranteed KOs Charizard at 32% even at -1 SpA. Protect keeps Incineroar safe from Prankster Encore. If Whimsicott Encores Gholdengo, Thunderbolt still resolves (same move) and Charizard dies; switch Gholdengo out next turn to break lock. Make It Rain KOs Whimsicott but drops SpA by 2 (to -3) and risks Heat Wave KO on Gholdengo — rejected. Parting Shot pivot is nice but Encore risk wastes the turn; safer to pivot next turn under last TR tick.

Archaludon switches into Thunderbolt resisted (0.5x) with Stamina boost, immune to Will-O-Wisp. Whimsicott's Prankster Encore locks Gholdengo into Thunderbolt, neutering its offensive presence. Incineroar's Parting Shot/Will-O-Wisp are blunted against Steel/Dragon. Preserves Whimsicott Focus Sash and sets up Archaludon ElectroShot/Thunderbolt for next turn while Gholdengo is locked.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 vs Rain core (Pelipper+Swampert-Mega). Farigiraf fainted T2. Gholdengo -1 SpA, Good as Gold (status immune), Leftovers. Incineroar Sitrus Berry, Intimidate active. Archaludon (Stamina, ElectroShot) + Whimsicott (Prankster Encore/Focus Sash) handle Gholdengo lock. Grimmsnarl (Prankster FoulPlay, Light Clay screens) reserved for Dark/Ghost threats. Drought cancels Rain; watch for Pelipper switch reactivating Rain + Mega Swampert Swift Swim. Trick Room (2 turns) + Tailwind (expired T4) speed control used. Charizard-Mega-Y preserved at 33% HP for late-game Sun offense if healed.

decisions.rationale: Make It Rain is the only move that can KO Whimsicott (84%, no Sash) even at -1 SpA, permanently removing the Encore threat. Parting Shot on Archaludon lowers its SpA (cutting ElectroShot/Flash Cannon damage) and pivots to Swampert for High Horsepower SE. If Encore locks Incineroar, it survives any Archaludon hit (max ~70%) and I switch it out next turn to break the lock. Protect is only 33% reliable and wastes utility if no Encore comes.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Opponent brought ZardY+Whimsicott+Archaludon+unknown 4th (Grimmsnarl/Stunfisk-Galar/Quaquaval). ZardY at 32%, Whimsicott at 84% (Sash broken by Fake Out T3). Archaludon Stamina Def+1, Modest, Leftovers. Gholdengo Good as Gold blocks all status moves including Encore — permanent immunity. No more TR available (Farigiraf fainted). Post-TR: opponent outspeeds entire team (Incineroar 80, Gholdengo 104, Swampert-Mega 70). Swampert-Mega Swift Swim useless without rain — use as slow physical breaker. Win condition: Gholdengo Thunderbolt KOs ZardY (32%), Make It Rain/Shadow Ball for cleanup, Swampert High Horsepower for Archaludon. Incineroar utility: Intimidate on switch, Parting Shot pivot, Fake Out only on switch-in turn. Watch for Quaquaval Moxie snowball and Stunfisk-Galar Mimicry EQ under terrain.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Incineroar Fake Out (+3 priority) outspeeds Electro Shot, flinching Whimsicott if it attacks. Gholdengo Make It Rain is a possible OHKO on Whimsicott (55-280%). Whimsicott Protect avoids both threats. Archaludon Electro Shot deals 25-70% to Incineroar, pressuring it while Whimsicott stays safe. Trick Room and Sun expire next turn, resuming normal speed where Whimsicott (184) outspears all foes.

Archaludon Stamina +1 Def, Electro Shot skips charge in Sun. Whimsicott Focus Sash intact, Prankster Encore/Fake Out priority. Grimmsnarl reserved for Dark/Ghost threats with Prankster FoulPlay + Light Clay screens. Charizard-Mega-Y at 33% HP for late-game Sun offense. Opponent core: Pelipper (Rain setter, Damp Rock), Swampert-Mega (Swift Swim), Klefki (Prankster screens). Rain cancels Sun; watch for Pelipper switch reactivating Rain + Mega Swampert speed control. Trick Room + Tailwind speed control used. Next turn: normal speed order, Whimsicott fastest, then Archaludon, then foes.

decisions.rationale: Archaludon is locked into charged Electro Shot targeting Gholdengo's slot — Protect blocks it for free. Encore fails on Swampert (no last move). Mega Swampert HH does ~33-70% to Archaludon after Def+2, putting it in KO range for next turn. Mega Evolve now for permanent Atk boost. Whimsicott can only Moonblast (chip) or Tailwind (manageable next turn).
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Opponent brought ZardY+Whimsicott+Archaludon+unknown 4th (Grimmsnarl/Stunfisk-Galar/Quaquaval). ZardY at 32%, Whimsicott at 84% (Sash broken T3). Archaludon Modest, Leftovers, Stamina Def+2, SpA+1 from Electro Shot charge. Gholdengo Good as Gold blocks all status moves including Encore — permanent immunity. Encore fails on targets that haven't moved (just switched in). No more TR (Farigiraf fainted). Post-TR: opponent outspeeds entire team. Swampert-Mega Swift Swim useless without rain — use as slow physical breaker with 222 Atk. Win condition: Swampert-Mega HH for Archaludon, Gholdengo Thunderbolt for ZardY (32%), cleanup with Make It Rain/Shadow Ball after switching to reset SpA-3. Incineroar utility: Intimidate on switch, Parting Shot pivot, Fake Out only on switch-in turn. Watch for Quaquaval Moxie snowball and Stunfisk-Galar Mimicry EQ under terrain. Switching Gholdengo out resets its SpA-3 stat drops.

decisions.rationale: Whimsicott outs Swampert guaranteed, sets Tailwind before foes move. Electro Shot hits Gholdengo for 25-73%, weakening it significantly. Archaludon may survive High Horsepower (31-84% at 78% HP) with +2 Def, and even if it falls, Tailwind persists for Grimmsnarl/Charizard-Y cleanup. Gholdengo at -3 SpA cannot threaten Whimsicott severely.

decisions.rationale: HH on Archaludon is the best progress play: even with Def+3 it does ~29% (based on T6 actual), bringing Archaludon to ~24%. Encore from Whimsicott doesn't matter since Swampert uses HH anyway. Switching Gholdengo out resets SpA-3 and brings Incineroar's Intimidate (Atk -2 on Archaludon). Next turn: Incineroar Fake Out flinches Whimsicott, Swampert HH KOs Archaludon. If Archaludon Protects, no loss—Incineroar still enters with Intimidate.

Switching Gholdengo out resets its SpA-3 stat drops. HH on Archaludon at Def+3 does ~29% (not a KO from 47%), needs 2 hits. Incineroar Thunderbolt damage from Archaludon SpA+1: ~24-73% range, Sitrus Berry mitigates.

decisions.rationale: Archaludon at 47% faces OHKO from High Horsepower (42-104%). Protect guarantees survival while Whimsicott's Moonblast pressures Swampert-Mega (11-55%). Whimsicott's Focus Sash absorbs retaliation. Maintains Tailwind advantage and keeps +3 Def Archaludon for late-game with Charizard-Y.

Archaludon Stamina +3 Def, Electro Shot skips charge in Sun, vulnerable to Ground at low HP. Whimsicott Focus Sash intact, Prankster Encore/Tailwind. Archaludon Electro Shot cannot OHKO Gholdengo (25-73%), Swampert High Horsepower OHKO range vs Archaludon at low HP. Tailwind active 3 turns, speed control advantage.

decisions.rationale: Fake Out (+3 pri) outspeedes Whimsicott Prankster Encore (+1), flinching it to prevent Encore lock on Swampert. HH chips Archaludon 53%→~24% (Stamina Def+3→+4). Electro Shot is 2-turn w/o rain so Archaludon's only damage is Thunderbolt on Incineroar (13-59% base, ~1.5x w/ SpA+1). Incineroar survives w/ Sitrus Berry. Swampert keeps full move flexibility next turn. Tailwind 1 turn left after this.
decisions.notebook: Electro Shot is 2-turn w/o rain (charge+attack; Power Herb/rain = 1-turn). Gholdengo Good as Gold blocks all status moves; resists Archaludon Thunderbolt (0.5x) and Flash Cannon (0.5x) — safe switch-in vs Archaludon. Stamina boosts Def on every hit (physical AND special). HH does ~29% at Def+3, ~22% at Def+4 — needs ~3 hits from 53% w/ Leftovers healing. Incineroar Fake Out (+3 pri) outspeeds Whimsicott Prankster Encore (+1). Gholdengo switching out resets Make It Rain SpA drops. Opponent sets: Archaludon Modest/Leftovers/Stamina; Whimsicott Timid/FocusSash(broken)/Prankster; ZardY Timid/CharizarditeY; Grimmsnarl Impish/LightClay/Prankster; Stunfisk-Galar Adamant/SitrusBerry/Mimicry; Quaquaval Jolly/LifeOrb/Moxie. Win con: grind Archaludon w/ HH, KO ZardY w/ Gholdengo Thunderbolt, Ice Punch Whimsicott. Watch Quaquaval Moxie snowball, Stunfisk Mimicry EQ.

decisions.rationale: Archaludon at 53% HP risks OHKO from locked High Horsepower. Switch to Grimmsnarl (100% HP, neutral to Ground) preserves momentum. Whimsicott Encore locks Swampert-Mega into High Horsepower, wasting its turn on Grimmsnarl. Grimmsnarl can set screens or FoulPlay next turn.

Double Protect blocks both, burns Grimmsnarl's Fake Out window (can't reuse next turn), and lets Tailwind expire. Even if opponent refreshes Tailwind or sets screens, avoiding the Encore disable is paramount — next turn Fake Out is gone and I can attack freely.

decisions.rationale: Grimmsnarl Prankster Fake Out outspeeds Incineroar Fake Out, flinching it to prevent flinch or Parting Shot pivot to Pelipper. Whimsicott Encore locks Swampert-Mega into High Horsepower (0.5x vs Whimsicott), denying Ice Punch 2HKO and preserving Focus Sash. Safe control line maintains Tailwind momentum.

Archaludon Stamina +3 Def, Electro Shot skips charge in Sun, vulnerable to Ground at low HP. Whimsicott Focus Sash intact, Prankster Encore/Tailwind. Grimmsnarl Prankster Fake Out + Light Clay screens. Charizard-Mega-Y 33% HP for late-game Sun offense. Opponent core: Pelipper (Rain, Damp Rock), Swampert-Mega (Swift Swim), Klefki (Prankster screens). Rain cancels Sun; watch for Pelipper switch reactivating Rain + Mega Swampert speed control. Archaludon Electro Shot cannot OHKO Gholdengo (25-73%). Tailwind speed control advantage. Swampert-Mega last move High Horsepower, Encore-locked.

decisions.rationale: Swampert's last move was Protect, so Whimsicott's Prankster Encore (+1) would lock it into Protect at 1/3 success before any damaging move fires. Switching to Gholdengo dodges Encore entirely and brings in a Good as Gold mon immune to all status. Incineroar Will-O-Wisp on Grimmsnarl burns it, halving Foul Play's physical damage. If Whimsicott retargets Encore to Incineroar, I can pivot Incineroar to Swampert next turn to reset.
decisions.notebook: Grimmsnarl Fake Out window burned turn 9 — cannot reuse unless it switches out and back. Whimsicott Encore locks target into last move used; if both active mons used Protect last turn, both are vulnerable. Gholdengo Good as Gold blocks Encore and all status — safe Encore-immune switch-in. Switching out resets Encore lock. Incineroar can only switch to Gholdengo or Swampert (Farigiraf fainted). Burn halves Foul Play damage (physical user penalty). Parting Shot switch fails when no benched mon available but stat drops still apply.
